credentials.description: Configure storage and embedding providers for your organization.
credentials.priority: Organization configuration takes precedence. When absent, platform defaults are used if available.

credentials.unverified: Saving credentials does not test connectivity or model compatibility. Verify the saved embedding profile from a collection.
credentials.formDescription: Secrets remain masked. Saving does not test the provider connection.
credentials.name: Credential name
credentials.referencedHint: You can rotate secrets. A destination used by a collection or file cannot be changed; create new credentials instead.
credentials.activate: Use for new configurations in this organization

credentials.deleteDescription: {name} will be deleted if no collection or storage destination references it.

usage.description: Review recorded resources and your organization limits.

audit.description: History of configuration, access, and quota changes. No secrets are recorded in this log.

keys.legacyHint: This legacy key has no catalog issuer binding. Create a new key to grant collection access.

documents.title: Document library
documents.description: Upload and inspect documents shared by your organization. Readers see documents from their authorized collections.
documents.detailDescription: Inspect the original, extracted text and collection links.
documents.emptyHint: Upload a TXT, Markdown, PDF or DOCX file, or ask a manager to add documents to an authorized collection.
documents.uploadHint: Choose UTF-8 TXT/Markdown, a text-based PDF or a DOCX file, up to 25 MiB. Extraction runs in the background. OCR is not available.
documents.invalidFile: Choose a non-empty TXT, Markdown, PDF or DOCX file of at most 25 MiB.
documents.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check your storage configuration, permissions and available quota, then try again.
documents.loadFailed: This document data could not be loaded. Check your access and try again.
documents.actionFailed: The action failed. Check your access, storage configuration and available quota, then try again.
documents.collectionsHint: Only collections you can manage are listed. Attach a ready document to grant its readers access. Start initial indexing from the collection; active indexes pick up attachments and later document changes in the background.
documents.previewHint: Markdown is shown as plain text. Each page displays up to 20,000 characters.

task.UPLOADING: Upload awaiting confirmation. Recovery can take up to five minutes.
task.FAILED: Processing stopped after {attempts, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}.

errors.UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The original upload is incomplete. Upload the file again.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Private storage is unavailable. Ask a manager to check its credentials and allowed endpoint.
errors.TEXT_INVALID: This file is not valid UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and upload it again.
errors.TEXT_EMPTY: No text was found in this file.
errors.ACCESS_REVOKED: The requesting member no longer has access. A current manager can retry.
errors.PROCESSING_FAILED: Processing failed. Retry or contact an administrator.

lifecycle.title: Versions and retention
lifecycle.description: Manage replacements, retained versions and private file cleanup.
lifecycle.deletedLibraryHint: Deleted documents are inaccessible to readers. Their retained metadata and cleanup status remain visible to library managers.
lifecycle.deletedEmptyHint: Documents you delete will appear here with their private file cleanup status.
lifecycle.deletedDescription: Inspect retained version metadata and follow private file cleanup.
lifecycle.replaceHint: Upload UTF-8 TXT/Markdown, a text-based PDF or a DOCX file, up to 25 MiB. The published original stays available until the replacement is ready. Collection links are preserved.
lifecycle.replaceFailed: The replacement could not be submitted. Reload to check the latest version, permissions, storage and available quota, then try again.
lifecycle.replaceRetentionHint: Choose 0–365 days, counted from this request, for newly retired versions. Files become eligible for removal after a newer version is published and this delay has passed. Active indexes and unexpired source references can retain them longer. Previously scheduled cleanup keeps its earlier eligibility date. Retained files continue to count toward storage usage.
lifecycle.deleteRetentionHint: Choose 0–365 days before remaining private files become eligible for removal. Zero schedules cleanup at the earliest opportunity, once active processing, index retention and unexpired source references allow it. Previously scheduled cleanup is never postponed. Storage usage is released only after cleanup succeeds.
lifecycle.deleteHint: Delete “{name}” from the library and every linked collection.
lifecycle.deleteWarning: Readers lose access immediately. This deletion cannot be undone from the dashboard, even during file retention. File removal runs in the background.
lifecycle.deleteFailed: Deletion failed. Reload to check the latest version and your permissions, then try again.
lifecycle.publishedHint: Preview and download show the published version. A failed replacement leaves that version available.
lifecycle.unpublishedHint: No version has been published yet. Follow processing or retry the latest failed attempt.
lifecycle.replacementPending: A version is being uploaded or extracted. Wait for it to finish before submitting another replacement.
lifecycle.deletedAt: Access was removed on {date}. File cleanup follows the retention deadline; retained metadata is for management only.
lifecycle.cleanupSchedule: Eligible for cleanup from {date}. Active processing, active indexes, unexpired source references or unavailable object storage can delay removal.

cleanup.FAILED: File cleanup stopped. Retained bytes still count toward storage usage.
cleanup.COMPLETE: File cleanup complete. Storage reservations and retained file usage have been released.

cleanupErrors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Private storage is unavailable. Check its saved credentials and allowed endpoint, then retry cleanup.
cleanupErrors.CLEANUP_FAILED: File cleanup failed. Retry or contact an administrator.

documents.extractionBudgetHint: PDF and DOCX files reserve an additional 10 MiB for extraction while processing. Storage usage is adjusted after extraction completes.

diagnostics.PDF_OCR_UNAVAILABLE: No usable text was found in this PDF. Scanned documents need OCR, which is not available.
diagnostics.PDF_ENCRYPTED: This PDF is encrypted. Upload an unencrypted copy to extract its text.
diagnostics.FILE_INVALID: The file is damaged or does not match its format. Export a valid copy and upload it again.
diagnostics.PARSER_LIMIT: This document exceeds the extraction limits for pages, paragraphs or extracted data. Split or simplify it and upload it again.
diagnostics.PARSER_TIMEOUT: Extraction took too long and was stopped. Try a smaller document or contact an administrator.
diagnostics.PARSER_UNAVAILABLE: The document parser is unavailable. Ask an administrator to check the worker, then retry extraction.

sources.heading: Heading: {heading}
sources.jumpHint: Enter a whole number from 1 to {total, number}.
sources.changedVersion: The published document changed. Reload its details to inspect the current source.
sources.warnings: {count, plural, one {# source has no extractable text.} other {# sources have no extractable text.}}
sources.emptyPage: No extractable text was found on this PDF page. It may be blank or contain only images. OCR is not available.
sources.emptyParagraph: No extractable text was found in this DOCX paragraph.

indexing.title: Indexing and search
indexing.failed: The operation could not be completed. Check your access and configuration, then try again.
indexing.loadFailed: This information could not be loaded. Your access may have changed.
indexing.readDenied: Reading this collection is not granted. Catalog administration alone does not grant content access.
indexing.manageDenied: You can inspect the index but cannot manage it.
indexing.profileGate: Indexing supports Ollama and Cohere with document-structure chunking and no parent-child expansion. Other providers and chunking profiles remain saved drafts.
indexing.presetHint: Choose a preset explicitly. Generic sends raw text; EmbeddingGemma uses its documented document and query prefixes.
indexing.preparationHint: Preparation is a literal prefix followed by a newline for both documents and queries. It is not a template.
indexing.discoveryHint: Discovery uses the saved credential binding. Save your model and dimensions before verifying the profile.
indexing.noModels: No supported embedding models were returned by the saved provider. Check its model availability and credentials.
indexing.metadataFieldsHint: Declare up to 20 typed fields. Keys use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
indexing.invalidFields: Each field needs a unique valid key.
indexing.savedRevisionHint: Verification and indexing use saved configuration revision {revision, number}.
indexing.activeHint: The serving generation receives document and metadata changes automatically. Save a new profile and review a rebuild to replace it without interrupting searches.
indexing.startHint: Attach ready documents from the library, then start indexing. Processing continues in workers.
indexing.usage: Active: {active, number} / {limit, number} chunks · retained: {retained, number} · reserved: {reserved, number} · temporary limit: {temporary, number}.
indexing.generationProgress: Revision {revision, number} · {published, number} / {total, number} documents published · {chunks, number} projected chunks.
indexing.taskProgress: {attempts, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} · {chunks, plural, one {# completed chunk} other {# completed chunks}} / {reserved, plural, one {# reserved chunk} other {# reserved chunks}} · updated {updated}.
indexing.chunksHint: Inspect the bounded passages and immutable source offsets stored for this generation. Token counts are explicitly labeled as estimates when applicable.
indexing.chunkInfo: Passage {ordinal, number} · {tokens, number} tokens {estimate, select, yes {(estimated)} other {(counted)}} · {published, select, yes {published} other {not published}}.
indexing.moreSources: Additional source spans are not displayed.
indexing.documentsHint: Library versions and searchable versions may differ while indexing catches up. Change metadata here; attach, replace or remove documents in the library.
indexing.documentVersions: Library version: {library, plural, =0 {none} other {#}} · indexed version: {indexed, plural, =0 {none} other {#}}
indexing.metadataHint: Update language, tags and declared metadata for {name}. Changes are indexed asynchronously.
indexing.noFields: Declare fields in the collection profile to add typed metadata.
indexing.metadataFiltersHint: All filters must match. For “one of”, enter one value per line. Use true/false for booleans and YYYY-MM-DD for dates.
indexing.playgroundHint: Compare hybrid, keyword and vector retrieval in one collection. Each result links to the exact indexed source version.
indexing.searchNotReady: An active readable generation is required to search this collection.
indexing.queryPlaceholder: Ask a question in French or English…
indexing.searchSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}} · {strategy} · {duration} ms.
indexing.underfilled: The bounded vector candidate set contains fewer eligible passages than requested. Keyword results may still contribute to hybrid retrieval.
indexing.noResults: No passages match this query and these filters.
indexing.scores: Keyword rank: {lexical, plural, =0 {none} other {#}} · vector rank: {vector, plural, =0 {none} other {#}} · fusion score: {rrf}.
indexing.sourceHint: {name} · indexed version {version, number}. Access is rechecked for every request. A new search is required when the source link expires.
indexing.emptySource: This source position contains no extractable text.
indexing.deletedHint: Deleted collections cannot be read or restored here. Inspect durable vector cleanup and retry failed tasks. Library originals are retained.
indexing.cleanupProgress: Deleted {date} · {pending, number} pending tasks · {failed, number} failed tasks.
indexing.deletedCleanupHint: Cleanup tasks for {name}. Content is inaccessible; only cleanup status and retries are available.

errors.ACCESS_REVOKED: Current membership or collection access no longer permits this operation.
errors.PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED: This saved profile is not supported for indexing. Use Ollama or Cohere with document-structure chunking and no parent-child expansion. Cohere requires the Generic input preset.
errors.CREDENTIALS_INVALID: The saved embedding credentials or approved endpoint are unavailable. Check the collection binding.
errors.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The saved model was not found or is not available at the configured provider.
errors.MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: The model does not expose the required native embedding capability or preset.
errors.MODEL_CHANGED: The saved revision, model identity or supported capabilities changed. Reload and verify the profile before retrying.
errors.DIMENSIONS_UNSUPPORTED: The model does not support the requested vector dimensions.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The embedding service is unavailable. Try again after the service recovers.
errors.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The embedding operation exceeded its deadline.
errors.PROVIDER_REJECTED: The embedding service rejected the request. Check credentials and model input limits.
errors.INVALID_PROVIDER_RESPONSE: The embedding service returned an invalid or inconsistent response.
errors.INPUT_TOO_LARGE: The prepared text exceeds the model’s bounded context budget. Reduce chunk sizes or preparation.
errors.VECTOR_BINDING_CHANGED: The vector destination changed. The saved generation cannot be retargeted.
errors.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The exact source version is no longer available for this operation.
errors.CHUNK_LIMIT: The document exceeds the configured passage bound.
errors.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The collection’s active or temporary passage quota is exhausted.
errors.PROCESSING_FAILED: Processing failed. Inspect the configuration and retry the task.
errors.REBUILD_IN_PROGRESS: Another candidate or retained table prevents this build. Finish or discard the candidate and wait for physical cleanup. Only one rebuild can run per organization.
errors.GENERATION_CONFLICT: The saved revision or serving generation changed, or another generation is already retained. Refresh the collection and review its current state.
errors.METADATA_INCOMPATIBLE: The metadata declarations or values are incompatible with a retained generation. Keep shared field types unchanged and use values supported by the saved profile.

rebuild.title: Review index rebuild
rebuild.description: Compare serving revision {active, number} with saved revision {draft, number} before starting a new generation.
rebuild.availability: The current generation continues serving searches while the replacement builds. The replacement becomes active only after it catches up with document and metadata changes.
rebuild.sameProfile: The saved profile matches the serving profile. Rebuilding still creates a new generation and recalculates its passages and vectors.
rebuild.requirements: Keep the current model, credentials and vector destination available while they serve searches. The replacement uses temporary passage capacity. Another rebuild must wait until the previous candidate or retired table is physically cleaned up.
rebuild.cleanupAfter: Eligible for cleanup after {date}. Active source references may retain it longer.
rebuild.cleanupPending: Cleanup is pending. Another build is blocked until this generation’s vector table has been removed.
rebuild.discardDescription: Discard generation {id}. {active, select, yes {The serving generation remains available for searches.} other {This collection will still have no searchable generation.}} Documents in the library are retained.
rebuild.discardCleanup: Background cleanup removes the discarded vector table. Wait for cleanup to finish before starting another build.
rebuild.activeAvailable: Revision {revision, number} is serving searches · {model} · {dimensions, number} dimensions.
rebuild.draftState: Latest saved revision: {revision, number}. {same, select, yes {This revision is active.} other {This revision is a draft for the next rebuild; searches still use the serving profile.}}
rebuild.denied: Rebuilding requires collection administration, document management and the corresponding organization permissions.
rebuild.previousResults: These results belong to the previous generation. Their source links remain usable until expiry while access is allowed. Run a new search to query the current generation.
rebuild.activePreview: {revision, plural, =0 {No active generation} other {Serving generation · revision #}}
rebuild.previewOnly: Candidate preview only. These passages do not serve searches until this generation is activated.
rebuild.profileLocked: The profile is locked while a candidate is building or failed, or its status cannot be checked. Retry or discard the candidate before changing the profile. The name and description remain editable.
rebuild.savedProfileHint: Saving profile changes prepares the next rebuild. Searches continue using the serving profile shown in the indexing section.
rebuild.startNeedsDiscard: Retry the failed initial build or discard it. A new build becomes available after its vector table has been cleaned up.

indexing.savedDiscoveryHint: Discover models for saved revision {revision, number} · {provider}.
indexing.discoverySaveFirst: The provider or model has unsaved changes. Save this profile before discovering models for it.
indexing.cohereCatalogHint: Choose a supported Cohere model and vector size from this local catalog. It does not verify credentials; save the profile, then verify the saved model.
indexing.coherePresetHint: Cohere uses native search_document and search_query input types. The Generic preset adds no model-specific text prefixes.
indexing.providerDraftOnly: Profiles for {provider} can be saved, but indexing and model verification with this provider are not available yet.
indexing.hostedIdentityHint: This fingerprint identifies the hosted model’s declared capability profile. Vectorix cannot verify Cohere’s hosted model weights with a digest.

discoverySources.LOCAL_RUNTIME: Models discovered from the saved local runtime.
discoverySources.HOSTED_CATALOG: Supported models from the hosted provider’s catalog.

indexing.cohereUnsupportedPresetHint: This saved preset is not supported for Cohere. Choose Generic to prepare an executable revision.
